facts.text: Jon expresses gratitude to Gina for her faith in him, stating that her support is a real boost.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! Your faith in me is a real boost. I'm gonna make my dreams come true!
Your faith in me is priceless - I won't let you down!

facts.text: Gina encourages Jon to keep pushing, stating that his dreams are close.

evidence.quote: Keep pushing and you'll get there. Your dreams are so close!
Take comfort in knowing you've got a solid community cheering you on, me included. Keep on pushing!

facts.text: Jon reaffirms his commitment to not quitting, even when it's hard, and states he will make his dreams come true.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! I won't quit, even when it's hard. I'm gonna make it!
I'm not gonna let anything or anyone stop me. I'll keep pushing and make my dreams come true.

facts.text: Jon thanks Gina for being a great friend and acknowledges her belief in him as meaningful.

evidence.quote: Your belief in me means the world. I'm not gonna let anything or anyone stop me.
Thanks, Gina! I won't quit, even when it's hard. I'm gonna make it!
